question: Compare merchandise sales for the scenario's two periods. If sales fell, identify the largest negative category contributions.

evidence.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'

SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY delta_brl LIMIT 5

decisions.reason: This directly measures the August 2018 minus July 2018 merchandise amount change needed to determine if sales fell.
The measured change from July to August is -40820.89 (a decline), so the next step is to identify the largest negative category contributions.

The change was negative (-40820.89 BRL), and the largest negative category contributions have already been identified (relogios_presentes, cool_stuff, ferramentas_jardim, moveis_escritorio, telefonia_fixa). The question is fully answered.
